text:
maria: Heads-up — release v2.14.0 promotion is blocked. eu-west scheduler nodepool got evicted, CI integration queue spiked, and a bunch of e2e jobs failing with DB connection timeouts. holding promotion for now.
aj: any links or logs? which CI job IDs?
maria: job 12234/12235 are the integration-e2e runs. logs show a lot of `connection timed out` to our test-db cluster. infra saw autoscaler churn.
deploy-bot: Deploybot automated: canary promotion blocked for v2.14.0 - job integration-e2e (12234) failed 11/12 tests. See: https://ci.company/1234 (raw).
kevin: quick glance at registry: we're seeing a flood of artifact reuploads after cache TTL expiry. registry returning intermittent 503s, which makes runners retry and pile up. snippet:
```
ERROR 503: artifact-push failed for redwood/runtime:v2.14.0
upload error: checksum mismatch / connection reset
```
ryan: can we just pin promotion back to the last good image (v2.13.7 sha256:abcd1234)? that unblocks customers while infra investigates.
olivia: we also need to decide on change window. Current plan was tonight at 23:00 UTC — if we hold, we should notify PMs + sales now.
samu: short-term mitigation: rerun integration jobs with reduced concurrency and smaller batch sizes. command I used before: `ci rerun --job integration-e2e --concurrency 2` — less pressure on DB and registry.
infra-oncall: I'm on it, looking at autoscaler logs. initial reading: spot node eviction + quota surge due to too many parallel runners; requesting temporary quota bump from cloud ops.
maria: OK I'm going to pin the canary promotion to v2.13.7 to stop the rollout traffic. @infra-oncall please follow up on quota and nodepool health.
deploy-bot: Deploybot automated: pinned promotion target -> v2.13.7 (was v2.14.0). Manual hold applied.
olivia: cool. can someone update the release-notes PR to reflect the hold and the rollback/pin? also mention follow-up hotfix branch.
aj: if infra can get a +10 quota tonight we might re-run and resume within the window. otherwise we should schedule a hotfix cut and a morning promotion.
maria: decision: HOLD change window. Pin to v2.13.7, schedule hotfix branch cut, update release notes + stakeholder notify. i'll open the release notes PR and post to #release-updates. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: noted — continuing investigation and chasing quota. will post ETA.
